skill.name: Trace Metadata Enrichment
skill.description: Attach or update key-value metadata on a running trace with optional prefix namespacing. Returns success status indicating whether metadata was applied.
skill.skill_body:
Call update_trace_metadata with a metadata dictionary and optional prefix parameter. The function applies the metadata to the current active trace context. If no prefix is specified, defaults to 'trace.metadata'. Returns a boolean indicating success.

## Objective

Enrich trace with contextual metadata during execution
## Applicable Signals

- Active trace context exists
- Metadata dictionary is non-empty and applicable
- Trace is in running state (not closed)

## Contraindications

- Trace is closed or finalized
- No active trace context available
- Metadata dictionary is empty or null

## Workflow Steps

- Verify active trace context exists
- Prepare metadata dictionary with key-value pairs
- Optionally specify prefix for namespace isolation
- Call update_trace_metadata(metadata, prefix)
- Receive boolean success status

## Constraints

- Must be called while trace is active
- Metadata parameter must be a valid dictionary
- Prefix parameter is optional; defaults to 'trace.metadata' if omitted

## Cautions

- Calling on a closed trace will fail silently or raise an error depending on implementation
- Large metadata dictionaries may impact trace performance

## Output Contract

- Boolean success status returned; metadata dictionary applied to current trace under specified prefix; metadata accessible for downstream trace inspection and analysis
